lines: After narrowly escaping the siege, we had gone through a tunnel off of the flood bypass and set foot in the remains of the hidden mine that spread through the underground below Tokyo.
...See? Now you understand why I said this way will also be dangerous, right?
F-For sure... this is dangerous all right...
They look super gross... Hebiko... is an octopus, but still gets goosebumps all over...
I think... I peed a little...
All three of us had gone pale at the creepiness of the monster crawling right in front of us.
Right in front of the tunnel where we were hiding...
...a worm-like demonic beast called a Devil Worm was crawling by.
Devil Worms were notorious for their ruthlessness and bottomless voracity, and it was said that even Taimanin couldn't avoid a struggle in a head-to-head fight.
Their original habitat is the Devildom. But Yomihara is nearby... so, I guess that's why.
Before anyone knew it, they started appearing on this side as well and built a nest in these tunnels.
They're a real nuisance. The tunnel survey was halted, and now the tunnels are sealed off can't even easily be used as passages...
Devil Worms were nesting in the remains of the mine.
Sana-san had known about them and that was why she had been hesitant to use this route.
Sana-san, those big worms, are there a lot of them in passages?
Hmmm, I think so...? I heard from the refugees that there might be a hundred, maybe two hundred or more of them in here.
Ah, no, no!! That's gonna be awful, Fuma!!
Before I fight against those huge, gross, scary things, I would rather just fight those refugees and UFS dudes from earlier!!
Calm down, Shikanosuke. I mean, I understand how you feel, but...
Devil Worms were easily over a meter in diameter.
They were almost big enough to fill the tunnel completely and they were so grotesque and bizarre that it was understandable for Shikanosuke to be so afraid of them.
Even if there are lots of them, that's with regard to the whole mine, right. It's not like we have to deal with all of them.
And, however big they are, they are still worms. If you use their characteristics to your advantage, they aren't a daunting adversary.
Yeah. Just let me handle themー
I glanced at the giant worm crawling through the tunnel and grinned suggestively.
